title: Prioritize Cash, Team, and Momentum—In That Order
primary_theme: Cash, Team, and Momentum as the Operating Order for Founders
founder_lessons: Prioritize cash first, because funding enables team building and team building creates momentum.
Spend meaningful CEO time recruiting direct reports and other A-level talent.
Prepare to explain how you arrived at the problem and what customer discovery you performed.
Use domain experts and customer references to validate whether the problem is real.
notable_quotes: three things, cash, team, and momentum in that order.
the CEO has to spend his or her time recruiting.
education is number one, two, and three.
